questions.en: How many countries introduced the euro as legal tender on 1 January 2002?

timeline.labelEn: Euro coins and banknotes introduced in twelve EU member states
timeline.labelDe: Einführung von Euromünzen und -banknoten in zwölf EU-Mitgliedstaaten

questions.notes: The twelve: Belgium, Germany, Finland, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Spain. Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, which used the lira or franc by agreement, switched at the same time but are not EU members; the euro existed as book money since 1999.
